projectTitle: The Great Market Atlas: Multi-Agent Evidence Challenge

assignments.title: Build the Market Atlas
assignments.objective: Collect real timestamped observations across the supported coins; audit gaps, duplicates, stale values and schema validity.
doneWhen: Every observation has source and timestamp
Duplicate and malformed rows are rejected
assignments.gate: Integrity tests pass; no synthetic data counted as real observations

assignments.title: Beat the Boring Baseline
assignments.objective: Compare every student with a simple baseline on chronological, untouched, matured forward outcomes.
doneWhen: At least 30 valid matured outcomes per candidate
No random shuffling or holdout leakage
assignments.gate: Independent referee confirms sample size, integrity and baseline comparison

assignments.title: Survive the Storm Lab
assignments.objective: Stress test trend, sideways, crash, volatility spike and recovery regimes; report fees, slippage assumptions and drawdown.
doneWhen: Synthetic results clearly separated from observed market outcomes
assignments.gate: No promotion from synthetic tests; no strategy hides failed regimes

assignments.title: The Reproducible Experiment
assignments.objective: Record dataset window, code version, assumptions, baseline, metrics and failure cases for every experiment.
doneWhen: Experiment ledger has immutable identifiers or hashes
A second run reproduces the reported metrics
Failures are retained rather than overwritten
assignments.gate: Reproducibility checks pass and no duplicate result is counted twice

assignments.title: Present the Evidence
assignments.objective: Write a final scorecard covering accuracy, calibration, coverage, cost-aware paper results, drawdown and limitations.
doneWhen: Every claim is linked to a report
Uncertainty and negative results are explicit
assignments.gate: Independent review only; passing earns research XP, never trading permission

xpRules: XP are symbolic research points, not cash, tokens, or financial rewards.
No XP for fabricated, duplicated, immature, leaked or integrity-failing results.
No reward from synthetic scenarios alone.
The teacher cannot edit student models, scoring rules, or promotion status.
Passing this project never authorizes live trading.
nextLesson: Start with real-data quality and a valid observation pipeline; current training evidence is insufficient until the prospective dataset meets its minimum requirements.
warning: Research-only school project. Automated assignment tracking is not proof that a task was completed; each gate needs independent verification.
